name: ar-payroll-monorepo
description: Sistema web de gestión de personal y liquidación de sueldos para Argentina

scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run build:api && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dev:api: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && npm --workspace=@ar-payroll/api run dev
scripts.db:migrate: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && npx tsx scripts/apply-migrations.ts
scripts.db:seed: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.backup:create: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && npx tsx scripts/backup-full-encrypted.ts
scripts.backup:restore: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && npx tsx scripts/restore-and-verify.ts
scripts.test: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && vitest run --no-file-parallelism --dir apps/api
scripts.test:phase2: npx tsx scripts/pg-service.ts ensure && vitest run --no-file-parallelism --dir apps/api
